get_agent.name: get_agent

parameters.description: The ID of the agent to retrieve.
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.description: Version of the agent to retrieve. Use `published` for the live version, or `draft` for the latest unpublished changes for the same agent. Defaults to `published`.
parameters.name: version

description.description: Short description of the agent, if provided.

organization_id.description: Unique ID of the organization that owns the agent.

schema.description: Input and output schemas for this agent. Omitted while the agent's graph cannot be previewed (e.g. an empty or structurally-invalid draft); check `validation` to see what needs fixing.

input.description: JSON Schema for the agent's `inputs` object. Use the top-level property keys as input field names when starting a run.

output.description: JSON Schema for the `outputs` object returned by `GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/runs/{run_id}`.

validation.description: Validation report for the agent's graph, when available. Use `validation.valid` to check the agent is publishable.

issues.description: Problems found while validating the graph. Empty when `valid` is true.

items.description: A single problem found while validating an agent's graph.

code.description: Stable machine-readable identifier for the kind of issue.

field.description: Name of the offending field on the node, if field-specific.

field_title.description: Display title of the affected field, if available.

node_id.description: ID of the node the issue applies to, if node-specific.

node_title.description: Display title of the affected node, if available.

violation.description: The specific constraint that was violated, if available.

valid.description: Whether the agent's graph is valid and ready to publish.

has_more.description: Whether a continuation page is available.

next_cursor.description: Continuation value, when supplied by the service.

get_agent_run.name: get_agent_run

parameters.description: The ID of the agent that owns the run.
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.description: The ID of the run to retrieve.
parameters.name: run_id

parameters.description: Include each step's raw `outputs` payload in the execution trace.
parameters.name: verbose

data.description: Status and result details for an agent run.

agent_id.description: Unique ID of the agent for this run.

error.description: Error details, when the run fails and error information is available.

finished_at.description: When the run finished, if it has completed.

outputs.description: Output values returned by the run, keyed by output-variable UUID. This UUID-keyed object is retained for compatibility and is empty when no outputs are available.

outputs_expanded.description: Expanded form of `outputs`, keyed by the same output-variable UUIDs. Each entry carries the agent's configured human-readable key as `title` alongside the returned value. `title` is null when the agent has no configured key for that output. Entries preserve the key order of `outputs`. The UUID-keyed `outputs` field remains the stable compatibility field.

started_at.description: When the run started, if it has started.

steps.description: Ordered step-by-step execution trace — one entry per node that ran, in execution order. Always present once the run has executed a node; per-node `outputs` inside each step are included only when the request asks for `verbose`.

items.description: One executed node in a run's step trace, in execution order. The lightweight fields always ship; ``outputs`` is populated only when the run-retrieve request asks for ``verbose``.

elapsed_time.description: Wall-clock seconds the node took, if recorded.

error_message.description: Failure detail for this node, when it failed.

finished_at.description: When the node finished, if it has.

node_id.description: ID of the node that ran, within its agent graph.

outputs.description: Raw output payload this node produced. Included only when the request asks for `verbose`.

status.description: Terminal status of this node execution.

has_more.description: Whether a continuation page is available.

next_cursor.description: Continuation value, when supplied by the service.
